shortDescription: Legal & General LSE:LGEN plans to reduce its headcount by roughly 10%, or about 1,000 jobs, by the middle of 2027, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, as CEO António Simões presses ahead with a drive to streamline the British insurer.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
